prefix.scope: serial prefix only; numeric live-set upper bound excludes ORT allocator, GC/browser/File/harness/reference and downstream; not production peak proof

downstream.scope: named spans and actual traffic; excludes allocator/GC/harness/private references; not production peak

stagingAndCopy.namedSpanScope: Per-phase source-derived extents may alias or occur at different instants. No sum is a measured host peak. ORT allocator copies/GC/File backing remain unknown.

harnessHostRetention.scope: Caller inputs, three private reference JSON objects, fresh artifact number arrays/string and observer copies coexist with operators. JSON UTF8 sizes are recorded by Python anchors; JS heap retention/GC is unmeasured.

actualExecutedSourceScope: New orchestration source and fixed-hash module/WASM resources loaded in this fresh realm; loading a module does not mean every exported function was called

instrumentationOverhead.scope: Hash snapshots/Response clones and browser/private-reference serialization add diagnostic traffic and GC pressure. Their host allocation peak is unmeasured.

anchors.reusedGuardScope: Fixed98-asset integrity and prior producer/reference receipt guards; old browser harnesses were not executed in this experiment
